name: Ikaros
description: A breathtaking giant swing reaching 93 metres above Stockholm with panoramic views over the city, archipelago and water. One of the world's tallest gyro swing rides and Gröna Lund's most iconic attraction.

name: Insane
description: A unique vertical spinning roller coaster where riders sit in cars that rotate 360 degrees freely as the train navigates the twisted track. A disorienting and thrilling experience unique to Gröna Lund.

name: Twister
description: A classic wooden roller coaster twisting and turning along the waterfront of Stockholm since 1985. A beloved park institution delivering traditional wooden coaster thrills with stunning harbour views.

name: Jetline
description: A classic steel looping roller coaster that has thrilled visitors since 1988. Featuring a full loop and multiple twists over the waterfront with spectacular views of Stockholm during the ride.

name: Fritt Fall
description: A giant freefall drop tower sending riders plummeting towards the ground at high speed. The tilting version adds an extra dimension of terror as riders are tilted forward before the drop.

name: Monster
description: An intense looping roller coaster with multiple inversions delivering powerful G-forces in a compact layout. One of Gröna Lund's most thrilling coasters for experienced riders.

name: Eclipse
description: A spectacular Star Flyer giant wave swinger ride with stunning views over Stockholm harbour and the archipelago. Riders swing out over the water in a breathtaking 360-degree experience.

name: Pumpen
description: A thrilling giant swinging ship ride that swings riders high into the air with powerful G-forces. A classic fairground experience delivering fun for the whole family.

name: Kvasten
description: A fun suspended family coaster themed as a magical broomstick ride. Riders dangle freely below the track as the train sweeps through turns and dips in this family favourite.

name: Spökhuset
description: Gröna Lund's classic haunted house dark ride taking visitors through creepy corridors and spooky scenes. A traditional fairground ghost train experience beloved by generations of park visitors.

name: Spindeln
description: Brand new for 2026! A Super Jumper family ride themed as a giant spider — the first of its kind in Sweden. Combines bouncing, spinning and speed for the whole family with space for 42 riders.

name: Vilda Musen
description: A classic wild mouse family coaster with sharp turns and surprising drops. A fun ride for the whole family with unexpected twists at every corner.
